payload.text:

Every token refresh request must have a timeout of exactly 60 seconds.
payload.title: Token refresh timeout

payload.text:

payload.text:
# Refund approval {#policy}

Refunds are issued only after the payment cancellation is approved.

payload.text:
# Production token refresh {#policy}

This rule applies only in production: at most one token refresh request may run at a time. This document sets no concurrency rule for other environments.
